title: Recorded replay: the agent run that built rounds 4–5 of this site
sources: Git commit times (exact) and session message times (minute resolution). Actions are paraphrased; nothing was invented. Round 4 session, round 5 handoff, and audit notes supply outcomes. Estimated intervals are bounds around work, not measured durations; they can include pauses. Commit spans are save points, not task durations. The 16 commits exclude the starting baseline. Roles count role types, not distinct agent instances. All and Tour apply across all nine stops. Browser totals count 59 entrance and 10 portfolio tests once; entrance also passed a second layout mode. The normal full test command and the audit browser checks remained blocked by dependency downloads.
